replicate_statements: Images are selected frames of PA time lapse with the photoactivated region represented by circles in euchromatin (red) or in heterochromatin (green) on the pre‐activation image.
outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative photoactivation images from transiently transfected cells, implying that multiple cells/experiments were performed, but the caption does not state how many cells or independent experiments these images are representative of, nor the type of replicate (e.g., biological replicates, independent transfections, number of nuclei imaged).

replicate_statements: Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: Panel B presents averaged intensity curves (with error bars in the insets) fitted with a diffusion model, indicating that data were pooled/averaged across multiple measurements, but neither the number of replicates (cells, regions, or experiments averaged) nor the type of replicate is reported anywhere in the caption.
